variables.name: cluster_id
variables.label: CourtListener opinion cluster ID
variables.definition: Unique CourtListener cluster identifier and primary key. Identifies an opinion cluster, not an entire lawsuit. Join other CourtListener records by this key; never substitute the reporter citation as a unique key.
variables.missing: Required.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: case_name
variables.label: Case caption
variables.definition: Case caption returned by pass 1, with the CourtListener input caption used as fallback if the response omits the field. It is not necessarily byte-identical to the source caption.
variables.missing: Blank if unavailable.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: court_sent_to_coder
variables.label: Court supplied in coding prompt
variables.definition: Court string actually supplied to the model. May be blank when the original metadata could not safely supply a district court; this is distinct from the subsequently attached court_id.
variables.missing: Blank means no court string was supplied.

variables.name: date_decided
variables.label: Opinion decision date
variables.definition: Opinion decision date carried from the coding input, based on CourtListener cluster date_filed. ISO YYYY-MM-DD in CSV; native daily date in Stata. Not the lawsuit filing date and not independently hand-verified.
variables.missing: Required.
variables.csv_representation: ISO YYYY-MM-DD text
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: codable
variables.label: Meets model codability gate
variables.definition: Pass-1 determination that the opinion fits the coding scheme, has a usable outcome, and satisfies the winner and substantive-dimension rules. False opinions remain in the data. Filter explicitly before substantive analyses.
variables.missing: Required; False is a substantive gate result, not missing.
variables.csv_representation: True/False text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: codable_reason
variables.label: Reason for codability decision
variables.definition: Model's short explanation of inclusion or exclusion. Free text, not a standardized exclusion classification or independently verified finding.
variables.missing: Blank if not supplied.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: casetype
variables.label: Raw primary case type
variables.definition: Primary substantive case type selected in pass 1. Codes 1-31, excluding discontinued 4 and 12. Raw outputs are preserved: 24 uncodable records retain a case type, so a nonmissing code alone does not establish codability.
variables.missing: Usually blank when codable=False; retained raw exceptions are documented.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: casetype_alternate
variables.label: Raw alternate case type
variables.definition: Optional second-best case type for a dispute crossing categories. This does not create a second observation and is not used to derive category or direction.
variables.missing: Blank means no alternate was reported.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: disposition
variables.label: Disposition of matter before court
variables.definition: Procedural outcome of the motion, petition, trial, or agency review before the court. A granted motion need not end the lawsuit; the moving party need not be the plaintiff.
variables.missing: Required. Literal none means no outcome; other is a substantive residual code.

enum_labels.motion_granted_in_part: Granted in part and denied in part

variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing

variables.name: prevailing_party
variables.label: Prevailing side in matter
variables.definition: Side described as prevailing: moving, opposing, mixed, or neither. Side names refer to the matter before the court, not fixed plaintiff/defendant roles.
variables.missing: Required; neither and mixed are meaningful values.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Local categorical codes.

variables.name: moving_party_name
variables.label: Moving party name
variables.definition: Name of the party bringing the motion, petition, or matter being decided.
variables.missing: Blank if not identified.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: moving_party_description
variables.label: Moving party role description
variables.definition: Short description of the moving party's role or interest, such as prisoner, employer, or regulator.
variables.missing: Blank if not identified.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: opposing_party_name
variables.label: Opposing party name
variables.definition: Name of the side opposing the matter being decided.
variables.missing: Blank if not identified.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: opposing_party_description
variables.label: Opposing party role description
variables.definition: Short description of the opposing party's role or interest.
variables.missing: Blank if not identified.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: focal_role
variables.label: Codebook focal-interest role
variables.definition: Pass-2 restatement of the focal interest specified for the primary case type. Identifies the interest whose success is coded liberal under the scheme; not necessarily the movant or plaintiff.
variables.missing: Blank when pass 2 was skipped or no response supplied.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: focal_party
variables.label: Side occupying focal role
variables.definition: moving or opposing identifies the side occupying the focal role; neither means no party was found to occupy it. Neither is a real coding result, not a failed API call.
variables.missing: Blank generally means pass 2 was not run; neither is distinct from blank.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Local categorical codes.

variables.name: focal_party_name
variables.label: Focal party name
variables.definition: Name of the party occupying the focal role, when identified.
variables.missing: Blank when the focal party is unidentified or pass 2 was skipped.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: focal_is_movant
variables.label: Focal party brought the matter
variables.definition: True when the focal party brought the motion or matter; False when it opposed it. Used by super-mechanical direction.
variables.missing: Blank when no focal side was identified or pass 2 was skipped.
variables.csv_representation: True/False text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: focal_prevailed
variables.label: Focal interest obtained relief
variables.definition: True means the focal party obtained relief; False means it did not; mixed means it won some issues and lost others. CSV tokens map to Stata 1=True, 0=False, 2=mixed; blank maps to missing. This is a three-state result, not a boolean.
variables.missing: Blank when no focal party was identified or pass 2 was skipped.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: 0=False, 1=True, 2=mixed; missing is separate.

variables.name: focal_reasoning
variables.label: Reason for focal-party result
variables.definition: Model's short explanation linking the focal role, party, and relief. An audit aid rather than independently checked legal reasoning.
variables.missing: Blank when unavailable or pass 2 was skipped.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: text_chars_original
variables.label: Original opinion text characters
variables.definition: Character count before the coder's context-budget shortening. Counts characters, not tokens or printed pages.
variables.missing: Blank if absent from the run record.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: text_chars_sent
variables.label: Opinion text characters sent
variables.definition: Character count after context-budget shortening, excluding surrounding prompt instructions.
variables.missing: Blank if absent from the run record.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: text_excerpted
variables.label: Opinion text was shortened
variables.definition: True if the coder shortened the opinion by retaining its beginning and end and eliding its middle. Enables sensitivity checks for shortened inputs.
variables.missing: Required.
variables.csv_representation: True/False text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: model
variables.label: Recorded model identifier
variables.definition: Recorded model ID, gpt-5.6-luna in this snapshot. Does not establish an immutable provider-side model checkpoint.
variables.missing: Required.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Local categorical codes.

variables.name: run_tag
variables.label: Original production run tag
variables.definition: Original run and shard tag. Nine extension shards are represented. One eligible carried-forward record retains the stopped all-years pilot tag; it passed input-equality checks and is not a duplicate.
variables.missing: Required.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Local categorical codes.

variables.name: prompt_version
variables.label: Prompt instrument version
variables.definition: Locked prompt version v1. Distinct from the later deterministic direction-rule version and this packaging version.
variables.missing: Required.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Local categorical codes.

variables.name: coded_at_utc
variables.label: Coding timestamp (UTC)
variables.definition: UTC timestamp recorded for the coded result. ISO text in CSV; native Stata clock milliseconds, interpreted as UTC. Stata clock values have no timezone attribute. Does not represent decision time.
variables.missing: Blank if absent from the run record.
variables.csv_representation: ISO UTC timestamp text with +00:00 offset
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: ai_casetype

variables.missing: Blank when casetype is blank or unparsable.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: ai_category

variables.definition: Deterministic roll-up from ai_casetype: 1 criminal justice, 2 civil liberties/rights, 3 economic regulation/labor. Not a separate model judgment.

variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing

variables.name: ai_casetype_era

variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: volume

variables.missing: Blank if unavailable.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: page
variables.label: Reporter first page
variables.definition: First page of the reporter citation: text in CSV and exact integer in Stata. Distinct decisions may share a starting page.
variables.missing: Blank if unavailable.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: docket_id
variables.label: CourtListener docket ID (raw text)
variables.definition: Raw CourtListener docket identifier; may repeat across opinion clusters. Some retained upstream values are malformed metadata fragments rather than numeric IDs. variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing

variables.definition: CourtListener court identifier attached through the docket. Original IDs are retained, including cadc on district opinions placed on appellate dockets. Use court_type and in_district_analysis for the existing analysis classification.

variables.name: court_type

variables.definition: Carp-Manning judge code obtained through the FJC nid to Senate Judges Paper crosswalk. When one nid maps to multiple codes, the code used most recently in Carp-Manning is retained. Value labels contain the original judge names.
variables.source: FJC directory; Senate Judges Paper crosswalk; Carp-Manning
variables.missing: Blank when no crosswalk code is available; not a newly assigned judge ID.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: cm_casnum
variables.label: Carp-Manning-style reporter citation
variables.definition: Citation encoding: series digit (1 F. Supp., 2 F. Supp. 2d, 3 F. Supp. 3d), three-digit volume, four-digit first page. Uses reporter_corrected. Text in CSV, exact integer in Stata; not unique and not a CourtListener cluster ID.
variables.missing: Blank if the citation cannot be encoded.
variables.csv_representation: Original text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: cm_month
variables.label: Carp-Manning-compatible opinion month
variables.definition: Month of date_decided, coded 1-12.
variables.missing: Blank if the decision month is unavailable.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: cm_circuit
variables.label: Carp-Manning-compatible circuit
variables.definition: Carp-Manning circuit code from the matched judge's district held on the decision date, falling back to the docket court. The court-code map uses modal linked Carp-Manning codes, preferring 2005-2012 when at least 20 records exist.
variables.source: CourtListener positions; empirical Carp-Manning court-code map
variables.missing: Blank for excluded nondistrict courts or an unavailable court map.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: cm_state
variables.label: Carp-Manning-compatible state
variables.definition: Carp-Manning state/territory code, using the same judge-district then docket-court preference as cm_circuit. May describe the judge's home district when sitting by designation.
variables.source: CourtListener positions; empirical Carp-Manning court-code map
variables.missing: Blank for excluded nondistrict courts or an unavailable court map.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: cm_statdist
variables.label: Carp-Manning-compatible district
variables.definition: Carp-Manning state/district code, using the same geography rule as cm_circuit. Do not interpret as an independently verified location of the decision.
variables.source: CourtListener positions; empirical Carp-Manning court-code map
variables.missing: Blank for excluded nondistrict courts or an unavailable court map.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: cm_appres
variables.label: Carp-Manning-compatible appointer code
variables.definition: Carp-Manning appointing-president code. Trump=45 is an extension to the original code vocabulary. President identity is translated from the linked appointment; Bush/Roosevelt are distinguished using appointment timing.
variables.missing: Blank without a usable appointing-president identity.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: cm_apyear
variables.label: First Article III confirmation year
variables.definition: Earliest Article III confirmation year in CourtListener for the matched person. Confirmation date was selected by agreement against Carp-Manning, rather than assuming start or nomination year. May precede appointment to the district in which this opinion was decided.
variables.source: CourtListener positions; date_confirmation chosen by validation
variables.missing: Blank without a matched person and usable Article III confirmation date.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: cm_gender
variables.label: Carp-Manning-compatible recorded gender
variables.definition: CourtListener recorded gender mapped to Carp-Manning: 0 female, 1 male. Describes source-recorded classification rather than an independently verified identity measure.
variables.missing: Blank without a matched person or mapped source value.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.

variables.name: cm_race
variables.label: Carp-Manning-compatible recorded race
variables.definition: CourtListener race values mapped to Carp-Manning's six codes. Multiple entries collapse by priority Black, Hispanic, Asian, American Indian, Pacific Islander, MENA, other, White; Pacific Islander/MENA/other map to code 6. This lossy compatibility field is not self-identification.
variables.source: CourtListener people-db race lookup; deterministic compatibility mapping
variables.missing: Blank without a matched person or mapped source value.
variables.csv_representation: Numeric text; empty field means missing
variables.coding_convention: Existing substantive codes or exact source values; no reassignment.
